en.t: It was truly like a waterfall falling without a sound!
That was roughly what the letter said.

units.source_text: 封好之后，他又口吟“如何可慰情”之句。

en.t: After sealing it, he again murmured the line, How can I soothe my feelings?

units.source_text: 然后宣召仆夫，将信交付。

en.t: Then he summoned a servant and handed over the letter.

units.source_text: 云居雁颇思看看对方的回信，她总想知道两人的关系究竟如何。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari very much wanted to see the other person's reply; she was always wondering what the relationship between the two of them really was.
